title: docs: specify how to use css classes to override styling
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Updates the documentation in flowchar.md to specify that:

- using external CSS to change styling doesn't work due to Mermaid internal styles having higher specificty
- using classDef syntax is the recommended approach to overriding styles

An example of this is also provided.

Resolves #6419 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

N/A - This PR just updates the docs.

author: Dripcoding

comments.author: Crell
comments.body: If this is the actual reason, it's very sad.  Being able to style a diagram with standard CSS would be extremely useful for reuable work.

comments.author: Dripcoding
comments.body: internally !important is applied to styles defined using class def and styles specific for nodes. I think another issue should be opened to explore how the project could remove `!important` from the different layers of styling.

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is an opinion/expression of sentiment about a limitation. It does not suggest a specific code or documentation change.
